name: Wastage and Damage Report
query:
SELECT
    w.component_item AS "Item Code:Link/Item",
    i.item_name AS "Item Name",
    w.department AS "Department:Link/URY Production Department",
    w.production_unit AS "Production Unit:Link/URY Production Unit",
    ROUND(w.wasted_qty, 3) AS "Wasted Qty:Float",
    w.stock_uom AS "UOM",
    ROUND(w.valuation_rate, 2) AS "Valuation Rate:Currency",
    ROUND(w.valuation_amount, 2) AS "Total Cost:Currency",
    w.valuation_is_estimated AS "Estimated Valuation:Check",
    w.reason_category AS "Reason",
    w.reason_notes AS "Notes",
    w.status AS "Status",
    w.captured_on AS "Captured On:Datetime",
    w.captured_by AS "Captured By",
    w.approved_on AS "Decided On:Datetime",
    w.approved_by AS "Decided By",
    w.branch AS "Branch:Link/Branch",
    w.name AS "Reference:Link/URY Issue Wastage"
FROM `tabURY Issue Wastage` w
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON (i.name = w.component_item)
WHERE
    w.branch = %(branch)s
    AND w.captured_on >= %(start_date)s
    AND w.captured_on < DATE_ADD(%(end_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR %(status)s = '' OR w.status = %(status)s)
    AND (%(department)s IS NULL OR %(department)s = '' OR w.department = %(department)s)
ORDER BY
    w.captured_on DESC,
    w.component_item
